title: By 9 months, most babies look when someone calls their name
summary: The CDC 9-month social list says most babies look when you call their name.
body: Looking when you call her name is on the CDC 9-month page under social and emotional milestones, not under the language heading. The page's heading is what most babies do by 9 months. A tip on the 4-month page also says a baby will start to recognize their name around 9 months. This card uses the 9-month milestone line, which is the looking response. It is not a hearing test. The age is the United States CDC mark.
